_comment: The Lightning pre-action record (2026-11-10). Installed on merge through the protected route. lightning_preaction_event holds one row per pre-action event (RLS on, no role holds a privilege, no foreign key). fn_lightning_preaction_record is the engine's batched write door (service_role only) and bounds retention to fourteen days; fn_lightning_preaction_trace reads one hand (service_role only).
